short: Zero-free region from arbitrarily large windows

statements.markdown: Statement 4.1 (zeroFree_of_rpow_window). Let 0 < θ < 1, ω > 0 and C be real. Suppose that for every Y 0 there is Y ≥ Y 0 with G F (y) ≤ C y θ for all y ∈ [Y, Y 1+ω ]. Then L(s, χ i ) ̸ = 0 for every i and every s with Re s > θ.

lean.name: Deduction.zeroFree_of_rpow_window
lean.plain: Zero-free region from arbitrarily large windows
lean.fidelity_note: `CharFamily` stores the admissible characters and their positive weights, and `Gm F` is their weighted real sum. Lean’s $\delta$ is the paper’s $\omega$. The hypothesis uses the same closed windows above arbitrarily large starting scales, and `ZeroFree` asserts nonvanishing for every family member with $\operatorname{Re}s>\theta$.
